_note: The choice (ADR-052, OI-85, OI-115; SIM_VERSION 126): every candidate's worth is the player's own imagined outcome, his reading and his appetite for risk already in it; he takes the best, even when it is bad. A poorly deciding actor takes the second-best if it is within `(1 - decision_making) * decision_bias` of the best's size. Removed 2026-11-15: reading_weight, risk_weight and floor (a formula that weighted the worth again by game reading and risk management, which the thought already weighs) and clarity_threshold (below it the carrier carried the ball whatever else was on).
_source: Prototype. Weights and bias: no cited figure; the form follows L0.11 section 4.5 (product, sum, clamp) and ADR-028 section 3 (arbitrary declared). decision_bias default 0.2 = 'a weak decider accepts a candidate 20% worse'; to be calibrated against real decision-error rates (L3). `decision_weight` removed in F.6-shape: it made decision inert on the argmax (OI-85). `perception_floor` and `perception_range` removed 2026-11-15 (OI-85): nothing read them since the thought (ADR-052) chooses what a player sees.
